title: Workflow, clear replies and calming angry customers

say: Workflow, clear replies and calming angry customers.
This is the video for module 2 of Online Customer Support.
Good agents do not just reply to messages. They move each request through the same steps every time, so nothing is missed.

panel.heading: Same steps, every customer
items: A workflow means nothing is missed
Clear writing is understood the first time
A complaint handled well wins a loyal customer

say: Most support work is writing. Clear writing saves time, because the customer understands the first time.

panel.heading: Same steps, every customer
items: A workflow means nothing is missed
Clear writing is understood the first time

say: And a complaint handled well can turn an angry customer into a loyal one.

say: Step one, acknowledge quickly. Hello Kemi, thank you for your message. I am checking your order now.

panel.heading: The six-step support workflow
items: Acknowledge quickly, with her name
Clarify: all questions in one numbered message
Check the record before you answer
Solve, or escalate with a short summary
Confirm the fix and check it worked
Log the case and label it Resolved

say: Step two, clarify in one message. Ifeoma asked: please send 1, your order number, 2, a photo of the shoes, 3, the size and colour you ordered. One message collected all the facts.

panel.heading: The six-step support workflow
items: Acknowledge quickly, with her name

Solve, or escalate with a short summary
Confirm the fix and check it worked
Log the case and label it Resolved

say: Step three, check before you answer. Never guess. A wrong confident answer causes a second complaint.

panel.heading: The six-step support workflow
items: Acknowledge quickly, with her name

Solve, or escalate with a short summary
Confirm the fix and check it worked
Log the case and label it Resolved

say: Step four, solve it, or escalate. Refunds, threats and suspected fraud go to your supervisor, with a short summary: who, what, what you checked, what she wants, and the deadline.

Confirm the fix and check it worked

say: Step five, confirm the fix, and later check it worked. Did the new pair fit well?

say: Step six, log the case and change the label to Resolved.

say: I will get back to you soon means nothing. Say a real time, and set a phone reminder for every time you promise.

Solve, or escalate with a short summary

panel.rule: Give a time, not just a promise: by 3 pm today, not soon.

say: Every reply has five parts. Greet her by name. Hello Amina.

panel.heading: The structure of a good reply
items: Greet and use her name
Acknowledge the request or feeling
Give the answer or action
State the next step and time
Close warmly

say: Acknowledge. I understand you needed it for Saturday.

panel.heading: The structure of a good reply
items: Greet and use her name
Acknowledge the request or feeling
Give the answer or action
State the next step and time
Close warmly

say: Give the answer, near the top, because customers on phones may not read to the end. Your parcel is in Abuja and will be delivered tomorrow before 4 pm.

say: State the next step. The rider will call you before arriving.

say: Close warmly. On chat, keep it to 2 to 4 short lines. And read every template once before sending, so you never send Hello, name in brackets.

items: Greet and use her name

say: Some words push customers away. Blame, a flat no, and vague times like as soon as possible.

panel.heading: Warm, calm, professional
left: You did not read the policy
right: I am sorry this was not clear
Let me see what I can do

say: Replace blame with explanation. Replace can't with what you can do. And replace vague words with real times.

panel.heading: Warm, calm, professional

Let me see what I can do

say: The first draft reply said: yes we can do it, price depends, send details. That tells the customer nothing.

card.title: A clear quote, not price depends

say: The rewrite gives a starting price: from about 3,500 naira per head.

card.title: A clear quote, not price depends

say: For 80 guests, that is roughly 280,000 naira, before delivery and serving staff.
Then it lists the exact details needed and promises the quote within 2 hours. The customer can decide at once.

card.title: A clear quote, not price depends

say: Mariam's customer, Tola, wrote in capital letters: I paid 12,500 last week and nothing. Mariam listened and restated: I can see you paid 12,500 and have had to message three times.

panel.heading: LAST in a written complaint
items: Listen: read everything, restate the facts
Apologise once, sincerely
Solve: offer choices with times
Thank her, then follow up

say: She apologised once: I am sorry, that is not the service you should get.

panel.heading: LAST in a written complaint
items: Listen: read everything, restate the facts
Apologise once, sincerely
Solve: offer choices with times
Thank her, then follow up

say: She checked. The address was missing a street name. She offered choices: delivery today by 5 pm, or pickup from 11 am.

panel.heading: LAST in a written complaint
items: Listen: read everything, restate the facts

say: She thanked Tola, sent the rider update, and checked the next day. Tola went from calling them scammers to saying thank you.

panel.heading: LAST in a written complaint

say: Do not blame the rider or the customer until you have checked. And never write calm down, or as I said before.

panel.heading: LAST in a written complaint
items: Listen: read everything, restate the facts
Apologise once, sincerely
Solve: offer choices with times
Thank her, then follow up
panel.rule: Apologise for her experience. Confirm fault before naming it.

say: Some cases are not yours to handle alone. Threats of harm, legal action or a public campaign, and product safety problems, such as a skin reaction or food illness, go straight to your supervisor or the owner. So do refunds and suspected fraud. Log every one.

panel.heading: Escalate to the owner at once
items: Threats of harm
Legal action or a public campaign
A skin reaction or food illness
Refunds and suspected fraud

say: To remember. Use the six steps every time, and ask all your questions in one numbered message. Write in five parts, with real times. Calm complaints with LAST.
And if a customer complains in public, reply once, briefly and politely, then move to a private chat.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Acknowledge, clarify, check, solve, confirm, log
All questions in one numbered message
Greet, acknowledge, answer, next step, close
LAST: Listen, Apologise, Solve, Thank
Public complaint: reply once, move to private

say: Your turn. Run one real or realistic case through all six steps. Write at least 6 templates and rewrite 3 weak replies. Then write a LAST reply to an angry message, and ask a friend how it feels to read.
